task.title: Push the Docker image to Amazon ECR
task.shortdesc: Upload the image to a private Amazon ECR repository so that AWS can run it.

ul.li: The AWS CLI is installed and configured.
A private ECR repository named helloworld exists.

info.codeblock: aws ecr get-login-password --region <region> | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin <account-id>.dkr.ecr.<region>.amazonaws.com

step.cmd: Tag the image with the repository address:
Push the image to the repository:

taskbody.result: The image appears in the helloworld repository in the Amazon ECR console.
